name: a11y-reflow-zoom-spacing-check
description: Tests every page at a 320 CSS px wide viewport for SC 1.4.10 Reflow, at 200% text zoom for SC 1.4.4 Resize Text, with the SC 1.4.12 Text Spacing override stylesheet, for SC 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus, and for SC 1.3.4 Orientation, using Playwright measurements of horizontal overflow and clipped text.
